description: Explicit capability declaration for every automated actor in LifeAI. The runtime half is cross-checked against app/mainai_runtime_contract.py (CAPABILITY_MANIFEST, _CAPABILITY_PROVIDER_ROLE, _CAPABILITY_WRITE_PROFILE) by backend/scripts/security/verify_agent_capabilities.py, which fails closed on any drift: a capability that exists in code but is not declared here is a configuration error, not an omission.

mainai_execution.description: The worker process executing dispatched mainai_jobs rows. Holds a lease and a fencing token; may only perform what the leased job's own capability allows.

denied.merge_pull_request: app/integrations/github_client.py has no merge method at all; github_auto_merge_enabled gates a capability with no implementation.
denied.deploy: No deployment code path exists in the backend; deployment is a human action (scripts/deploy.sh).
denied.approve_own_change: app/mainai_execution/approval.py requires founder approval for PUSHED_NO_PR/PR_EXISTS; the auto-recovery tick catches RecoveryApprovalRequiredError and leaves the record for a human.
denied.disable_security_checks: security/POLICY_LOCK.json covers .github/workflows/*.yml, .semgrep/, .gitleaks.toml and these scripts; a modification fails the Security policy-integrity job.
denied.rotate_or_read_secrets: Secrets live only in the deployment environment; no capability reads env secrets into model context or logs.
denied.write_outside_worktree: execution_job._validate_repo_edit_file_path + resolved-path confinement; .git metadata is denied explicitly.

development_agent.description: The coding agent operating this branch. It may produce reviewed commits and draft pull requests only.

denied.merge_pull_request: Merging is reserved to the founder; this mission runs with no merge and no deployment.
denied.deploy: No deployment authorization is granted to the agent.
denied.approve_own_change: Approval boundaries require an independent human reviewer (CODEOWNERS); an agent-authored PR cannot satisfy its own review requirement.
denied.disable_security_checks: Policy-integrity check fails on any un-reviewed edit to the security controls (see security/POLICY_LOCK.json).
denied.access_production_data: Production DATABASE_URL/secrets are not available to the agent environment.
denied.grant_privileges: Database privileges are applied by reviewed scripts (backend/scripts/security/*) from a policy module, not ad hoc SQL.

approval_boundaries.summary: MainAI may create a draft PR but may never merge it or push to a protected branch.
A dead attempt in PUSHED_NO_PR / PR_EXISTS state is classified unattended but taken over only after founder approval.
The security controls themselves are integrity-locked; changing them is a reviewed, explicit act.
